workflows.name: Self-service IT request
setupNotes: No workflow design was supplied for this process. This entry is a placeholder so the intake form below has a valid workflowRef; it does not describe classification, diagnosis, resolution or confirmation steps.

Design the actual actions, owning group and routing with provia-workflow-designer before import. The plugin's bundled examples/it-service/workflow.yaml shows one reasonable shape for this kind of process (a training draft, not an approved design for this project) and already anticipates replacing its manual trigger with a self-service form.
The prefix ITR is proposed, not confirmed; it determines the case reference shown to requesters once a workflow auto_number is configured.

fields.label: Your full name
fields.help: Auto-filled when you are signed in, if the configured access model captures the authenticated user; editable otherwise. See decision D1.
fields.mapsTo: proposed case requester field, pending workflow design

fields.label: Your work email
fields.help: Used to send updates about this request.
fields.mapsTo: proposed case contact field, pending workflow design

fields.label: Department / team
fields.help: Optional — helps route the request faster.

fields.label: Phone (optional)
fields.help: Only needed if you prefer to be contacted by phone.

fields.label: What do you need help with?
fields.help: Choose the option closest to your request; add detail in the description below. Kept as a single flat select, not a dependent sub-type list, because form option definitions do not preserve dependent-option bindings.
fields.mapsTo: proposed category field, pending workflow design

fields.label: How urgent is this?

options.label: Low – no immediate impact on my work
Medium – limited impact, I have a workaround
High – I cannot work until this is resolved

fields.help: Describes impact, not a guaranteed response time; no service level is confirmed for this process.
fields.mapsTo: proposed urgency field, pending workflow design

fields.label: Short summary
fields.help: One line describing the request, e.g. "Laptop won't turn on".

fields.label: Details
fields.help: Describe what you need or what went wrong, when it started, and any error messages or steps to reproduce.

fields.label: Affected device, application or system
fields.help: E.g. asset tag, application name or hostname, if known.

fields.label: Attach a screenshot or file
fields.help: Optional. Accepted file types and maximum size are configured in Provia; confirm before publishing. See decision D3.

fields.label: Needed by (optional)
fields.help: Informational only — not a confirmed service-level commitment.

fields.label: I understand this request will be logged and I may be contacted for more information.

decisions.question: What is the respondent access model for this form: authenticated internal employees only, or an unauthenticated/external link (for example, for contractors)?

The IT request workflow itself (classification, diagnosis, resolution, confirmation actions, owning group, due dates) has not been designed. Only a placeholder workflow entry exists so this form can bind to it.
File upload type/size limits and retention for attachments (e.g. screenshots) are not confirmed for this Provia environment.

No source procedure (SOP) was supplied for IT requests. The field list, urgency levels and confirmation wording are drafted from generic self-service ITSM practice and need validation against the actual internal process.
